General Terms and Conditions

Terms and
conditions.

Effective from 2 October 2026

This is a translation. In case of any discrepancy, the Croatian version prevails.

1. General provisions

These General Terms and Conditions (the “Terms”) govern the relationship between R.D.D., obrt za računalno programiranje, vl. Milan Trbojević, Mihovilići 2b, 51000 Rijeka, Croatia, OIB 09887105714, MBO 98224476 (“RDD”) and the client (the “Client”).

The Terms apply to all RDD services: custom software development, websites, online shops and mobile applications, digital transformation, consulting, technical support and maintenance, and design. Where an individual offer or contract differs from these Terms, the offer or contract prevails.

2. Offers and conclusion of contract

Prices in the price list on the website are indicative; prices marked “from” are starting prices. For each project RDD prepares a written offer describing the scope of work, the price and the deadlines. An offer is valid for 30 days from issue, unless stated otherwise.

The contract is concluded when the Client accepts the offer in writing (including by email). By accepting the offer the Client confirms that they have read and accept these Terms.

3. Prices and payment

  • All prices are in euros (EUR). RDD is not registered for VAT; no VAT is charged under Art. 90(1) of the Croatian VAT Act.
  • Unless agreed otherwise in the offer, projects are paid 50% in advance on acceptance of the offer and the remainder on delivery.
  • Hourly work (programming, consulting, design, technical support) is invoiced monthly for the time actually spent, in 15-minute increments.
  • Maintenance is paid monthly in advance.
  • Invoices are payable within 15 days of issue. RDD may charge statutory default interest on late payments.
  • If the Client is more than 30 days late with a payment, RDD may, after a written warning, suspend work and maintenance services until the debt is settled.

4. Deadlines and cooperation

Deadlines are set out in the offer and start once the advance payment and the materials needed to begin work have been received. The Client undertakes to provide content (texts, images, access credentials), feedback and approvals in good time and to appoint a contact person. If the Client is late with these obligations, deadlines are extended accordingly.

5. Changes to the scope of work

Requests not covered by the accepted offer are additional work. RDD will first provide an estimate of cost and time and will carry out the work only after the Client's written approval. Unless agreed otherwise, additional work is charged at the current hourly rate from the price list.

6. Delivery and acceptance

After delivery the Client has 8 days to review the deliverables and report any defects in writing. If no defects are reported within that period, or if the Client starts using the deliverables in regular operation (e.g. publishes the website), the delivery is deemed accepted. RDD fixes reported defects free of charge, after which a new 8-day review period begins.

7. Warranty

RDD fixes free of charge any errors, i.e. deviations from the agreed specification, that the Client reports within 3 months of acceptance. The warranty does not cover defects caused by changes made by the Client or a third party, improper use, changes to or discontinuation of third-party services (hosting, payment systems, APIs, app stores), or new browser and operating system versions released after delivery.

8. Copyright

Once the Client has paid the agreed price in full, the exclusive right to use the work created specifically for the Client (source code, design, graphics), unlimited in time and territory, passes to the Client. Until full payment all rights remain with RDD.

RDD retains the rights to general code, tools, libraries and know-how developed or used independently of the project and may use them in other projects. Open-source components and third-party products (fonts, photos, plugins) are used under their own licences. RDD may show the project in its portfolio and references unless the Client objects in writing.

9. Client materials

The Client warrants that they have the right to use all content they provide (texts, images, logos, data) and is responsible if its use infringes the rights of third parties.

10. Confidentiality

Both parties keep confidential all business information, access credentials and data about the other party learned during the cooperation, also after it ends. Where RDD processes personal data on the Client's behalf as part of the service, the parties will conclude a data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR.

11. Liability

RDD is liable for damage caused intentionally or by gross negligence. In all other cases RDD's liability is limited to the amount the Client paid for the service in question in the last 12 months, and RDD is not liable for lost profit or indirect damage. RDD is not liable for the operation and availability of third-party services. The Client is responsible for regularly backing up their data, unless backups are expressly part of an agreed maintenance service.

12. Maintenance

Unless agreed otherwise, maintenance contracts are concluded for an indefinite period and either party may terminate them in writing with 30 days' notice. The scope of maintenance (updates, backups, number of included support hours) is set out in the offer.

13. Termination

Either party may terminate the contract if the other party materially breaches its obligations and does not remedy the breach within 15 days of a written warning. On termination the Client pays for the work done up to the termination date; the advance is retained up to the value of the work done and any excess is refunded.

14. Consumer clients

If the Client is a consumer, the Croatian Consumer Protection Act also applies, and nothing in these Terms limits the consumer's statutory rights, including liability for material defects.

If the contract is concluded at a distance (e.g. by email) or off-premises, the consumer may withdraw from it within 14 days of its conclusion without giving any reason, by sending a statement to info@rdd.software. If the consumer expressly asks RDD to start work before that period ends and then withdraws, they pay a proportionate part of the price for the work done until withdrawal. The right of withdrawal ends once the service has been fully performed, if the consumer gave express consent and acknowledged that they would thereby lose the right of withdrawal.

Consumers may send written complaints to info@rdd.software or to RDD's registered address. RDD will confirm receipt and reply in writing within 15 days. Consumers may also turn to alternative consumer dispute resolution bodies, listed on the website of the Croatian ministry responsible for consumer protection.

15. Personal data

RDD processes the Client's personal data in accordance with the Privacy Policy.

16. Governing law and disputes

These Terms and all contracts are governed by the law of the Republic of Croatia. The parties will try to settle disputes amicably. Failing that, disputes with business clients fall under the jurisdiction of the competent court in Rijeka, and disputes with consumers under the court determined by law.

17. Changes to the Terms

RDD may change these Terms by publishing a new version on this page. Changes apply to contracts concluded after publication; existing contracts remain subject to the version in force when they were concluded.
